subject.title: fix(agents): use fetchWithSsrFGuard in minimax-vlm.ts instead of raw fetch

question: After resolving the branch conflict, should the MiniMax VLM path retain the shared configured-origin exception while preserving the resolver’s metadata/link-local exclusions and explicit private-network semantics?
rationale: The patch is intentionally changing an SSRF boundary for configured endpoints; the source direction is aligned with the shared transport, but an owner should confirm the exact rebased behavior because a conflict resolution can change the security-sensitive inputs.

options.title: Rebase and preserve shared policy
options.body: Resolve the conflict without reintroducing a MiniMax-specific policy, then rerun the focused MiniMax and image-routing checks on the exact rebased head.

options.title: Narrow configured-origin trust
options.body: If maintainers do not want configured local origins to retain the shared exception, narrow that contract centrally and update the MiniMax path and coverage consistently.

recommendation.title: Rebase and preserve shared policy
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict without reintroducing a MiniMax-specific policy, then rerun the focused MiniMax and image-routing checks on the exact rebased head.
